violated_contract: Consolidation may not treat an asynchronously accepted vector publication as searchable context. The 2026-09-07 hosted native-memory trial observed six empty queries and only found the existing preference about 28.2 seconds after Jobs acknowledged publication, allowing an inference without the existing candidate.
canonical_prevention: The existing immutable artifact owner records complete publication size and per-vector ANN proof. Actual tenant-scoped queries filter by the immutable publication ID, avoiding top-K tie exclusion. A bounded admission step repairs missing/legacy projections through the existing outbox, retains proofs across continuations and rejects a changing projection sequence before inference without consuming model attempts.
